MuScriptor Local — Apple Silicon

1. Unzip “MuScriptor Local - Apple Silicon.zip”.
2. Move “MuScriptor Local.app” into your Applications folder and open it.
3. Let the app install its private Python environment. Internet is needed once.
4. Accept the Large model terms at https://huggingface.co/MuScriptor/muscriptor-large.
5. Create a Hugging Face read token at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens.
6. Paste that token into the app, then click Connect & Download Large.
7. Drag in audio and get MIDI. After installation and model download, it works offline.

This is a personal, locally signed app, not an Apple-notarized commercial release.
macOS may require you to explicitly approve opening it in System Settings →
Privacy & Security. Only open a copy received from someone you trust.

Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later. Large is a substantial
model; the tested machine has 64 GB memory. Expect slower performance on smaller
Macs. Allow roughly 10 GB of free disk space for the environment, model and setup.

Your own Hugging Face account/license acceptance is required. Model use is
non-commercial under CC BY-NC 4.0 plus the conditions on the model page.
No credentials, model weights, recordings, or MIDI files are included in this zip.
Audio and inference stay on your Mac; Hugging Face is used only for setup/download.

Environment: ~/Library/Application Support/MuScriptor Local/Engine/
Fallback MIDI files: ~/Library/Application Support/MuScriptor Local/Results/
Model cache: ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--MuScriptor--muscriptor-large/
Logs: ~/Library/Logs/MuScriptor Local/ (also available in the app menu)

Repair Dependencies in the app menu can repeat setup if something is missing.
To update this shared copy, quit, replace the app with a newer shared version,
then choose Repair Dependencies to refresh its private engine from that version.
To uninstall: quit, trash the app and its Engine folder. Save any MIDI files in
Results before removing that folder. Optionally remove the model cache above.
Do not remove unrelated Hugging Face caches or shared credentials.

Official engine: https://github.com/muscriptor/muscriptor (MIT code license).
The bundled official source and its license are inside the application Resources.
